name: ELIX System Monitor
description: Real-time operating system telemetry dashboard, process manager, and hardware diagnostics for ELIX OS

get_system_metrics.name: get_system_metrics
get_system_metrics.description: Sample real-time OS telemetry including overall CPU load, per-core utilization, RAM usage, and GPU statistics

includePerCoreCpu.description: Include individual CPU core utilization percentages

includeGpu.description: Include GPU load and VRAM metrics if hardware sensors available

list_processes.name: list_processes
list_processes.description: Enumerate active system processes with resource consumption statistics and search filtering

sortBy.description: Column field to sort process list by

limit.description: Maximum number of processes to return

filterQuery.description: Optional search term to filter process names

kill_process.name: kill_process
kill_process.description: Terminate a target process by PID with safety checks for critical kernel processes

force.description: Force kill without waiting for graceful shutdown

get_disk_io_stats.name: get_disk_io_stats
get_disk_io_stats.description: Fetch real-time disk transfer rates, active response latency, and partition capacity

get_network_io_stats.name: get_network_io_stats
get_network_io_stats.description: Fetch real-time network throughput (upload/download bytes per second) and active interface metrics

get_system_overview.name: get_system_overview
get_system_overview.description: Fetch complete high-level system hardware summary including OS build, uptime, CPU model, and total RAM
